---
title: "10. Research Specialisation"
---

::: {.module-meta}
**Duration:** 6–12 months  
**Outcome:** Move from replication to a working-paper-level contribution.
:::

Choose one primary and one secondary research stream:

1. Causal foundation models
2. Learning mechanisms
3. Economic/AI agents
4. Economically structured foundation models
5. Relational economic foundation models

The research workflow is:

$$
\text{paper} \rightarrow \text{reproduce} \rightarrow \text{stress test}
\rightarrow \text{find failure} \rightarrow \text{economic explanation}
\rightarrow \text{new method}.
$$

[See the specialisation map →](../../specialisations/index.qmd)
